credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}}, and operating profit rose by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}, although depreciation charges rose on an unfavourable base effect.

Total debt was stable at {{total_debt@FY2025}} and net debt was stable at {{net_debt@FY2025}}, so the earnings growth brought gross leverage down by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}.
Interest coverage improved by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2025}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2025}}, and FFO to debt rose by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}.

Free cash flow increased by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}}, lifting FCF to debt to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}, while capex intensity eased by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and cash liquidity fell by {{cash_liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity@FY2025}}.
Cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, a thinner buffer against a debt stock of {{total_debt@FY2025}}.
The TAV group's guarantee of part of the Antalya concession bank loan no longer exists at year-end after the refinancing of the previous bank loan.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2025}} to {{passengers@FY2025}}, with traffic growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2025}}.
Revenue grew by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}}, faster than passenger volumes, reflecting the international airport portfolio as well as Paris traffic.
The tariff period ran in a legal framework outside an economic regulation contract, with the annual tariff-setting procedure still requiring user consultation and regulatory approval.

peer_positioning.text: Groupe ADP has the weakest EBITDA margin of the airport peers ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}}), at {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} against a median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}.
Gross leverage is above the peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}} and ranks {{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}} in the group.

Interest coverage of {{interest_coverage@FY2025}} and FFO to debt of {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}} both sit below the peer medians of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@FY2025}} and {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}, ranking {{interest_coverage.peer_rank@FY2025}} and {{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2025}} respectively.
Capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}} puts the group in the middle of the airport peers.

snapshot.text: Groupe ADP, the Paris airport group that also consolidates TAV Airports, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}} in FY2025, with the renewed Ankara Esenboga concession entering service during the year.
The EBITDA margin widened by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} and net leverage fell by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}}.

The point to watch is liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, and the group's leverage and cash-flow ratios remain below the airport peer medians.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, leaving less headroom against a debt stock that was stable at {{total_debt@FY2025}}.
Cash flow against debt: FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}, so debt reduction depends on further earnings growth.
Profit: profit for the year fell by {{profit.change@FY2025}} to {{profit@FY2025}} as depreciation charges rose.
Contingencies: a dispute before the Turkish courts over the withholding tax rate on dividends from a Turkish subsidiary remains a contingent liability.
